# Generated third-party checkouts

`build.sh` populates this directory with pinned third-party dependencies:

- `aurora/`
- `phosg/`
- `resource_dasm/`
- `audio-prefix/` (local install prefix for audio dependencies)

These generated directories are ignored by Git. See [`../THIRD_PARTY.md`](../THIRD_PARTY.md) for revisions and roles.
